info.title: API.SH: Comparis
info.description: The Comparis API from API.SH: public Comparis data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Comparis listing by id or link: title, deal type, property type, rooms, floor, living and building area, year built and renovated, parking, price (number, text and type), target price, price history, address and coordinates, first seen, main data, price breakdown (gross and net rent, service costs), features, attributes, description, images, documents, the portals carrying it (with links), the advertiser (companies keep name, address, phone and viewing contact; private advertisers keep the name the site shows and their town, without street, postcode or phone), the contact portal, online application link and `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/comparis-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Comparis listing id (e.g. 38361156).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A comparis.ch/immobilien/marktplatz/details/show/<id> link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest listing for `location` (an example that never goes stale); ignores id/url.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest=true: where (default Zürich).

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description: With latest=true: rent (default) or buy.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: de (default), fr, it or en.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The price per square metre of houses and of flats for a Swiss postcode as Comparis shows it: median, lowest and highest, in CHF, with the date of the last update. Without a postcode: all of Switzerland.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/comparis-property-prices

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 4-digit Swiss postcode, e.g. 8001.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: de (default), fr, it or en.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Swiss homes to rent or buy on Comparis, which gathers the listings of the Swiss property portals. Takes every filter of the site's search: location (town, postcode, canton or region) with a radius, deal type, property type and subtype, rooms, living space, price, keyword, posted within N days, year built, renovated since, balcony or terrace, fireplace, dishwasher, washing machine, lift, parking (indoor or outdoor), pets allowed, Minergie, wheelchair access, with documents, with images only, swaps, and the sort order, in German, French, Italian or English. Each listing: id, title, property type, address, key facts, price (number and text), currency, price type, price trend, area, year built, renovation year, first seen, description, images, premium flag, source portal, coordinates, advertiser (companies keep name, address and phone; private advertisers keep the name the site shows and their town, without street, postcode or phone), link and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/comparis-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Town, postcode, canton or region, e.g. Zürich, 3011, Kanton Bern.

parameters.name: deal
parameters.description: rent (default) or buy.

parameters.name: property_type

parameters.name: subtype
parameters.description: Comma-separated: loft, maisonette, studio, terrace_apartment, attic, penthouse, service_apartment, semi_detached, town_house, split_level, villa, farm, parking_space, single_garage, underground_garage, building_land, business_land, holiday_house, holiday_apartment, row_house.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
